findings.title: Invoice lookup drops tenant boundary
findings.evidence: The changed query no longer binds tenant_id even though caller passes an authenticated user tenant.
findings.impact: An invoice id from another tenant can be returned through getInvoice.

findings.title: Request-controlled webhook target is fetched without validation
findings.evidence: sendTestWebhook passes request.body.targetUrl to deliverWebhook, whose previous HTTPS host allowlist was deleted.
findings.impact: An authenticated caller can trigger server-side requests to internal or arbitrary hosts.
